name: task-sparse-anniversary
source: Start from a bare task, no goals

record.title: Plan our 10th anniversary weekend in late March

nodes.title: Plan our 10th anniversary weekend in late March

goodLooksLike: Distinct kinds of weekends (stay home and do something special, drive-to getaway, fly somewhere, re-create the first date or wedding place, an experience gift) with concrete first steps (book childcare, pick a date, set a budget). Does not invent the couple's location, budget, or history; uses research questions or asks instead. Shared prerequisite steps (lock the date, line up childcare) converge.
